card.name: Aerospace and military aviation context
card.fires_on: Linking or punctuation words (says, in, for, an opening parenthesis, a comma) in aerospace, aviation, space-agency or air-force text. The word itself is ordinary; the setting is what matters.

modes.label: After aviation or space speakers
modes.description: A verb or title word right after a named expert or official in aerospace news.
modes.example: “was pretty much a show-stopper for supersonic transports,”<< says>> Drela.

modes.label: After agency or program names
modes.description: An opening parenthesis or small word after an aviation or space organization name, where an acronym or next detail follows.
modes.example: the International Civil Aviation Organization<< (>>ICAO) defines an international standard atmosphere

modes.label: Military aircraft procurement
modes.description: Small words inside air force or aircraft contract and proposal descriptions.
modes.example: the service issued a request<< for>> proposals (RFP) for the new

card.writes: It pushes toward aviation, air force, aircraft and missile words, including Chinese terms for aviation.
card.plain: It marks text about aircraft, air forces and space agencies, and prepares the next word to be aviation-related.
